q: Find the highest common factor of 36 and 84.
Three numbers which are co-prime to each other are such that the product of the first two is 551 and that of the last two is 1073. The sum of the three numbers is ?
e:
Since the numbers are co-prime, they contain only 1 as the common factor.

Also, the given two products have the middle number in common.

So, middle number = H.C.F. of 551 and 1073 = 29;

First number = 551/29 = 19; Third number = 1073/29 = 37.

Required sum = (19 + 29 + 37) = 85.

q: Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 3. If their L.C.M. is 48. what is sum of the numbers?
e:
Let the numbers be 
2x and 3x

LCM of 2x and 3x=6x  

Given that LCM of 2x and 3x is 48

=> 6x=48
6x=48
=> x= 48/6= 8



Sum of the numbers =2x+3x=5x

= 5 × 8 = 40

q:
The 30 members of a club decided to play a badminton singles tournament. 
Every time a member loses a game he is out of the tournament. 
There are no ties. What is the minimum number of matches that must be played to determine the winner ?
e: Clearly, every member except one (i.e. the winner) must lose one game to decide the winner. Thus, minimum number of matches to be played = 30 - 1 = 29.

q: What was the day of the week on 28th May, 2006?
e:
28 May, 2006 = (2005 years + Period from 1.1.2006 to 28.5.2006)
Odd days in 1600 years = 0
Odd days in 400 years = 0
5 years = (4 ordinary years + 1 leap year) = (4 x 1 + 1 x 2) 6 odd days
(31[jan] + 28 [Feb]+ 31[Mar] + 30[April] + 28[May] ) = 148 days
148 days = (21 weeks + 1 day) 1 odd day.
Total number of odd days = (0 + 0 + 6 + 1) = 7 0 odd day.
Given day is Sunday

q: X was born on March 6, 1993. The same year Independence Day was celebrated on Friday. On which day was X born?

Number of days from March 6, 1993 to August 15, 1993.
   Mar   Apr   May   June   July   August
= 25 +  30 +  31  + 30  +   31  +   15 
= 162 days = 23 weeks + 1 day.
Clearly, the day on March 6 will be the same as on August 14, i.e., Thursday.

q:
A man rows to a place 48km distant and back in 14 hours. 
He finds that he can row 4km with the stream in the same time as 3km against the
stream. Find the rate of the stream
e:
Suppose he moves 4km downstream in x hours
Then, downstream a= 4 / x km/hr
Speed upstream b = 3/ x km/hr
48 / (4 /x) + 48 / (3/x) = 14
12x + 16x = 14
x = 1/2
a=8 km/hr ,b = 6 km/hr
rate of stream = ½ (8 – 6 )
=  1 km/hr

e:
Let speed of boat is x km/h and speed stream is y km/hr
6(x+y) = 8(x-y)
6x+6y = 8x-8y
14y = 2x
7y = x
x/y = 7/1 
7 : 1

q:
A boat covers a certain distance downstream in 1 hour, while it comes back in 1.5 hour. 
If the speed of the stream be 3 kmph, what is the speed of the boat in still water ?
e:
Let the speed of the boat in still water be x kmph. Then,
Speed downstream = (x + 3) kmph
Speed upstream = (x − 3) kmph
∴ (x + 3) x 1 = (x − 3) x 1.5
⇒ x + 3 = 1.5x - 4.5
⇒ x = 15 kmph.
